user.title: Nooie
user.description: The URL of the go2rtc server in the Nooie add-on. The default works on Home Assistant OS and Supervised. If you mapped the add-on ports to the host instead, use http://127.0.0.1:1984.

error.cannot_connect: The go2rtc server at that URL did not respond.
error.no_streams: The server responded, but it has no Nooie streams. Make sure that the Nooie add-on runs and that one camera or more is online.
